data.title: Raw chicken vase formal dinner centerpiece
data.audience: Pinterest users who save maximalist tablescapes, strange interiors, dopamine decor, and funny housewarming gifts
data.hook: An elegant candlelit dinner table contains one tiny pale-pink ceramic plucked chicken serving as the floral centerpiece.

product.name: SAANG & JAT quirky pink ceramic raw-chicken vase (ASIN B0G9M9XPSX)

references.lesson: Preserve the small glossy light-pink ceramic vessel, upright plucked-chicken silhouette, folded wing forms, two legs, rounded body, and open floral neck; never render real poultry texture or feathers.

notes: The concept was selected after three product-derived directions were compared in the v6 README.
The product-specific dinner-versus-floral collision fails the swap test and is not a reusable product-card layout.
